walkthrough: Goal: sketch with a pencil, ink with a pen and shade with a soft brush, each at the size and opacity wanted, take back a mistake, and find the drawing looking the same after closing the app.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library. At the right end of the top bar, left of Layers, sits the Brush button (a slanted brush). Over the canvas's left edge, centred, floats the side bar: the size slider on top, the opacity slider under it, then undo and redo (grey: nothing drawn yet). The pen draws with the Ink Pen at 12 px, full opacity: the brush every stroke used before brushes could be chosen.
Draw a line with the pen: a hard black line that swells with pressure.

Tap the Brush button: the brush panel drops down under it, over the canvas, like the layer panel (opening one closes the other). Header Brushes; three rows, each a name and a light stroke the brush painted: Pencil, Ink Pen (highlighted), Soft Brush.

Tap Pencil: its row is highlighted at once and the size slider jumps to the pencil's own size. Draw with the pen on the canvas outside the panel: the panel closes and a thin grey-black pencil line appears, lighter where the pen pressed softly, grained like paper.

Drag the size slider up with a finger: while the finger is on it a bubble beside the side bar shows the size in pixels; lift it and draw: a wider pencil line. Drag the opacity slider down to about 40 % (the bubble shows the percentage) and draw: a fainter line. A contact that starts on the side bar never paints.
Tap the Brush button, tap Soft Brush, draw a wide stroke across the lower part: a soft-edged band whose strength follows pressure.
Tap undo in the side bar: the soft stroke is gone; tap redo: it is back. Brush, size and opacity changes are not steps of the history; only strokes are.

Leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: every stroke looks exactly as before, the soft brush is still the brush, the size slider stands where it was; the pencil kept its own size and opacity, the ink pen its 12 px.

Failure: a broken stored toolbox starts the brushes at their defaults; it never keeps the drawing from opening. A brush changed in a later version leaves strokes drawn before as they were (they keep their recipe).
Not here: colour (the ink is black until S12), the eraser, importing or editing brushes, the left-handed mirror of the side bar, pen feel, which the author judges on the tablet.
